title: Fluency & Interaction
description: Develop the conversational fluency and interactive skills needed to engage in longer, more natural discussions: expressing opinions, agreeing and disagreeing, asking follow-up questions, and managing conversation flow. Perfect for B1 learners who want to communicate more confidently and naturally.

lessons.title: How to Share What You Think

content.content: {"time":1700050001000,"blocks":[{"id":"oA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Expressing opinions fluently requires more than just 'I think'. Native speakers use a range of phrases to introduce, emphasise, and justify their views."}},{"id":"oD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"Phrases for Opinions","level":3}},{"id":"oG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Introducing: In my opinion / To my mind / As far as I'm concerned / Personally, I think...","Emphasising: I strongly believe / I'm absolutely convinced that...","Hedging: I suppose / I tend to think / It seems to me that...","Justifying: ...because / ...since / The reason I think this is... / This is mainly because..."]}},{"id":"oJ0kK1lL2m","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Example: Personally, I think remote work is very beneficial, mainly because it reduces commuting time and gives people more flexibility."}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: As far as I'm concerned, learning a foreign language is one of the best things you can do. I strongly believe it opens your mind to new cultures and ways of thinking.
In ___ opinion, social media does more harm than good. ___ I'm concerned, it's mainly because people compare themselves to others too much. I ___ believe that limiting screen time is essential.

questions.text: Which phrase introduces a personal opinion?
Which word best connects an opinion to its reason?

content.content: {"time":1700050002000,"blocks":[{"id":"agA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"In English conversation, it's important to agree and disagree politely. Direct disagreement can seem rude. Use these phrases to keep the conversation friendly."}},{"id":"agD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"Agreeing","level":3}},{"id":"agG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Exactly! / Absolutely! / That's a good point.","I couldn't agree more.","You're absolutely right.","I think so too."]}},{"id":"agJ0kK1lL2m","type":"header","data":{"text":"Disagreeing Politely","level":3}},{"id":"agM3nN4oO5p","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["I see your point, but...","That's true to some extent, but...","I'm not sure I agree with that.","Actually, I think it's slightly different...","I take your point, however..."]}},{"id":"agN1oP2qQ3r","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Tip: Softening words like a bit, slightly, to some extent, and not entirely make disagreements sound much more polite."}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

questions.text: Someone says: 'Fast food is terrible for your health.' You want to politely disagree. Which response is best?
options: I see your point, but it depends on how often you eat it.

content.content:
{"time":1700050003000,"blocks":[{"id":"fqA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Good conversationalists don't just answer questions — they ask follow-up questions to show interest and keep the conversation flowing naturally."}},{"id":"fqD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"Types of Follow-Up Questions","level":3}},{"id":"fqG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Clarifying: What do you mean exactly? / Could you explain that a bit more?","Elaborating: Really? What happened then? / And how did that make you feel?","Checking understanding: So, are you saying that...? / If I understand you correctly...","Showing interest: That's interesting! / Wow, I didn't know that."]}},{"id":"fqJ0kK1lL2m","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Example exchange:
A: I used to work in Japan for two years.
B: Really? What was that like? What did you do there?"}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: I've just come back from a hiking trip in the mountains. Really? That sounds amazing! How long were you there for? And did you go alone or with friends?

questions.text: A friend says: 'I had a really bad day.' Which is the best follow-up question?
Which phrase checks if you have understood correctly?
options: So, are you saying that you prefer working from home?

content.content: {"time":1700050004000,"blocks":[{"id":"adA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"A very common task in speaking tests and everyday conversation is to discuss the pros and cons of an issue. Here is the language you need."}},{"id":"adD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"Presenting Advantages","level":3}},{"id":"adG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["One of the main advantages is...","A major benefit of this is...","It has the advantage of..."]}},{"id":"adJ0kK1lL2m","type":"header","data":{"text":"Presenting Disadvantages","level":3}},{"id":"adM3nN4oO5p","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["On the other hand...","One drawback is that...","However, there is a downside..."]}},{"id":"adN1oP2qQ3r","type":"header","data":{"text":"Reaching a Conclusion","level":3}},{"id":"adO2pP3qQ4r","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["On balance, I think...","All things considered...","Taking everything into account..."]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

phrases.text: One of the main advantages is the flexibility.
phrases.translation: Одним из главных преимуществ является гибкость.

phrases.text: On the other hand, it can be very expensive.
phrases.translation: С другой стороны, это может быть очень дорого.

phrases.text: All things considered, I think it's worth it.
phrases.translation: Взвесив всё, я думаю, оно того стоит.

phrases.text: One drawback is that it takes a lot of time.
phrases.translation: Одним из недостатков является то, что это занимает много времени.

content.text: Living in a big city has many benefits. ___ the main advantages is easy access to jobs and culture. ___ the other hand, cities can be expensive and noisy. ___ balance, I think city life suits me.
